This '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' was active during the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He perished after his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was destroyed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces under command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
